revenue.source: FY2026 revenue 215,938 and FY2025 130,497: Q4 FY26 press release (8-K acc. 0001045810-26-000019). FY2024 60,922: FY2024 10-K (from memory of filing; not re-verified this session)

operating_income.source: FY2026 130,387 and FY2025 81,453: Q4 FY26 press release (8-K 0001045810-26-000019). FY2024 32,972: FY2024 10-K (not re-verified this session)

capex.source: Purchases related to property and equipment and intangible assets, cash flow statement, FY2026 10-K (0001045810-26-000021)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY26 growth was 65%; Q1 FY27 guidance of ~$78B/qtr implies strong FY27 (>$300B run-rate); fade to mature growth as law of large numbers and competition bite.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY26 GAAP EBIT margin 60.4% (130,387/215,938); modest haircut for competition and mix/pricing normalisation.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. blended effective rate near 16-17% in recent years; US 21% statutory offset by FDII and credits.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY26 D&A 2,843/215,938=1.3%, slightly higher as capex rises.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY26 capex 6,042/215,938=2.8%; rounded up for growing supply-chain/infrastructure investment.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM, rf ~4.3%, beta ~1.7-1.8, ERP ~5%, almost no debt; rounded to 10%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: at/below long-run nominal GDP growth; conservative given huge base.

net_debt.source: Short-term debt 999 + long-term debt 7,469 minus cash, equivalents and marketable securities 62,556 (Q4 FY26 press release, 8-K 0001045810-26-000019); leases excluded.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares, FY2026 10-K (acc. 0001045810-26-000021), millions
